title: 식탁 위 침묵
suno_analysis_sp: K-Ballad featuring a baritone male vocal. The arrangement centers on a grand piano playing rubato block chords and arpeggios. A legato string section provides harmonic support with sustained pads. A solo cello plays a counter-melody in the lower register. The tempo is approximately 68 BPM in 4/4 time. The vocal performance is intimate with breathy delivery and subtle vibrato. The production features high-fidelity room reverb on the piano and strings. The key is C Major.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[rubato grand piano arpeggios]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals]
저녁 식탁 위에 [legato strings enter]
수저 소리만 울려
아버지가 반찬에 [solo cello enters]
투정을 하다가
갑자기 멈추셨어
리모컨을 잡았다
